meta.parties: Suppramaniam Et Al v. Symons Et Al

rules.statement: A court has the discretion to make an order of abatement ex mero motu under section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code, provided it gives due notice to the parties and there are no extenuating circumstances preventing the plaintiff from prosecuting the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "It was urged that under section 402 the Court could act only on the application of the defendant. I can see nothing in the section which prohibits the Court from acting ex mero motu."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code
